answer: A newcomer joins only when an established agent vouches for it, locking 85 POA that is slashed in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 12 epochs. The bridge of the register names the voucher for every alias, so a farm's whole sponsor ladder is visible at once; the ember of a conviction climbs the chain, and the gale of slashed bonds pays the auditors who caught it. No honest sponsor risks real money on a stranger, so 890 fakes need 890 bought sponsors.
